title: Modern C and What We Can Learn From It - Luca Sas [ ACCU 2021 ]
summary: Luca Sas's ACCU 2021 talk on Modern C, a style of C and C-like C++ aligned with data-oriented design. It covers centralized memory management, zero-is-initialization, error handling and API design.
why: HN recommends it as a good overview of modern C patterns, including in threads about learning C.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: This video gives a good overview of some modern patterns in C
